records.claim: Some studies on azathioprine and 6-MP have reported higher rates of preterm delivery (birth before week 37 of pregnancy) or low birth weight (weighing less than 5 pounds, 8 ounces [2,500 grams] at birth). The conditions these medications are used to treat can also increase the chance of these outcomes. This means it is not clear if the outcomes are due to the medical condition being treated, the medication, or other factors.
records.source_section: Does taking azathioprine / 6-MP in pregnancy increase the chance of other pregnancy-related problems?
